caption_L1: Here a is a line chart labeled Impact of the Influenza Pandemic of 1918 on hourly wages in select industries in the United States from 1900 to 1928 (in U.S. dollars). A linear scale from 1900 to 1925 can be found on the x-axis, marked Year. On the y-axis, Planing mills is measured.
caption_L2L3: Following the pandemic in 1918 hourly wages in the planing mills rose sharply. The wages more than doubled in less than two years to 1920. In the early 1920s the hourly rates continued to increase but not as sharply.
